subject: Kickstart: AtlasFin hands-on (hybrid vs onsite) — schedule and runbook
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Alex Li <alex.li@atlasfin.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickstart: AtlasFin hands-on (hybrid vs onsite) — schedule and runbook

Alex —

Thanks again for the demo call last week. Per our conversation, we want to get a 1-day hands-on kickstart scheduled: a short prompt review + routing walkthrough in the morning, then an afternoon load/throughput run (burst routing + KV cache warm-up) and a short wrap with next steps.

Two quick questions we want to lock down before I book:
- Do you prefer an onsite session at your SF office (we can bring a small Redwood crew + a spare GPU node) or a fully virtual day?
- Your preferred dates (we have a couple of engineers available the weeks of Sep 13 and Sep 20).

Notes about logistics: if onsite, we'll need room booking with network access that allows outbound TLS to our staging endpoints (we can provide IPs). If virtual, we'll do a gated Zoom with screen sharing and optional recording; we ask permission to record only the technical segments for internal debrief.

Attached is a draft agenda (atlasfin-poc-agenda-v1.pdf) and a short sample prompt pack. If you can confirm dates and format I’ll circulate a calendar invite and pre-run checklist (routing/topology, sample prompts, expected throughput).

— Markus
Markus Klein | Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: atlasfin-poc-agenda-v1.pdf (agenda), sample-prompts.txt (prompt examples)
From: Alex Li <alex.li@atlasfin.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Romero <sarah.romero@atlasfin.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickstart: AtlasFin hands-on (hybrid vs onsite) — schedule and runbook

Hi Markus —

Thanks — this looks great. We’d prefer onsite if possible: our QA team wants to watch the load runs and we can isolate the traffic in the lab. Sep 20 would work best for us (we can do Sep 21 as a backup).

A couple of asks from our side:
- Can Redwood bring a small test node (NVIDIA A100 or equivalent) or do you want us to open remote access to our internal GPU pool?
- For visitor access, our building requires a visitor list 48 hours before arrival and a signed NDA for any on-prem tooling.
- We need confirmation on whether the session (or parts of it) will be recorded — legal will need that for the NDA.

Also, we’ll have: myself (product), Sarah Romero (QA lead), and our infra lead (TBD) onsite. I can send their names once confirmed.

Thanks,
Alex
Director of Product, Atlas Financial
alex.li@atlasfin.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Li <alex.li@atlasfin.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 13:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickstart: AtlasFin hands-on (hybrid vs onsite) — schedule and runbook

Alex —

We’re happy to do onsite Sep 20. Quick logistics notes from operations:
- Please send the visitor list (full name, email, company) by Sep 18 so security can issue badges.
- For network: if you want us to bring a node, that’s simplest — we’ll ship a pre-configured rackable dev box (we’ll need a 1Gbps ethernet drop and outbound ports 443/8443 open). If you prefer to use your GPU pool, we’ll need a short VPN or SSH tunnel setup instructions and a test account created ahead of time.
- Recording: Redwood policy is to ask for explicit consent. We will only record the code/demo portion. If legal requires, we can provide a separate recording consent form.
- AV/room: please confirm whether the room has 1 HDMI and one conference camera. If not, we can bring a portable camera and a small capture box (see attached room-layout.png for recommended setup).

I’ll hold the afternoon for the throughput run (14:00–16:30) and send a calendar hold once Markus confirms the shipped-node vs local GPU approach. Ben will lead the load test checklist.

— Laura
Laura Bennett | Operations Program Manager
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Li <alex.li@atlasfin.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2026 09:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickstart: AtlasFin hands-on (hybrid vs onsite) — schedule and runbook

Alex / team —

If we’re running the load tests onsite, here’s the pre-run checklist I’ll use (short):
1) Confirm test node spec (A100 / 80GB) or confirm VPN access to your GPU host.
2) Confirm sample prompt set and sequence (we received sample-prompts.txt but please flag any prompts that are PII-sensitive).
3) Network baseline: run a 5-minute ping and bandwidth check to the node while guests are present.
4) KV cache warm-up: we’ll run a 30-minute warm-up at low concurrency before the official runs.
5) Routing/backoff simulation: we’ll ramp concurrent connections from 2 -> 40 over 15 minutes, then spike to 80 for a 3-minute stress window.

I attached a compact prompt pack (sample-prompts.txt) with labels for what we’ll use in the throughput runs. If you’d like a safety cutoff (token/time budget) we can set hard limits so QA can safely stop a run.

If you confirm the node approach, we’ll ship the box on Sep 13 FedEx overnight and do a quick remote smoke test on Sep 17 to validate connectivity.

— Ben
Ben Carter | Performance Engineer
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments: sample-prompts.txt
From: Alex Li <alex.li@atlasfin.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickstart: AtlasFin hands-on (hybrid vs onsite) — schedule and runbook

Markus / Laura / Ben —

All looks good — we’ll take the shipped node approach. Confirmed: Sep 20 on-site at 09:00–17:00. Attendees: Alex Li (product), Sarah Romero (QA), Miguel Santos (infra). I’ve kicked off the visitor approvals and uploaded the signed site NDA to the link below for your legal team.

Two final asks:
- Can Redwood limit recording to the demo windows (10:15–11:00 and 15:00–15:30) and mark the recordings as internal only? Legal requested that earlier recorded content be deleted after 30 days unless otherwise authorized.
- For routing tests: can you provide a short .csv with the planned concurrency/time steps so our infra lead can map it to our monitoring?

I’ve attached the signed NDA and a link to our internal monitoring workspace (we’ll share access to the infra lead prior to Sep 17).

Thanks — see you Sep 20.

Alex
Director of Product, Atlas Financial
